children.text: ED1 is a very consistent money-maker and a good avenue for players to practice using AoE abilities, movement, avoiding damaging mechanics and DPS rotations. The requirements to feasibly solo it are moderate and many deaths should be expected when learning the dungeon due to the nature of the mechanics.
is fine for learning, but prioritise using defence reducing abilities for special attacks (
) on Masuta and Seiryu's face. Also, expect to do additional cycles on Seiryu.
Additional items to bring if possible, or acquire if you can afford to.
The first boss you encounter. Sanctum uses primarily slow
auto attacks which hit moderately hard. However, they are aimed at the players' tile instead of character so you are able to dodge them by stepping away 3 or more tiles before they hit.

⬥ Sanctum's attack pattern is:
    • Start of fight: 4x Ranged autoattack to start the fight.
    • Rest of fight: Water Burst → Ranged auto → Water Jet → Ranged auto → Purple Smoke → Melee auto → repeat
    • After the 4th water jet attack, 2 Crassian Reinforcements are summoned.
    • The melee auto does nothing if you are out of melee range.
​
⬥ A projectile that targets the spot the player is standing on and hits in a 3x3 area.

• Targeted to a tile rather than the player and has travel time before it hits
    • It is possible to dodge every Ranged autoattack simply by moving before the attack lands (not necessary).
​
⬥ Sanctum ducks down and rises back up quickly, splashing water and dealing heavy
as soon as you see this mechanic as it is very fast. You can also

    • Staying or moving out of range in time will cause the attack to miss. Doing this is usually unnecessary.
⬥ Sanctum spews water, rotating from North anti-clockwise, dealing ~6000 soft typeless damage if the player is caught in it.
• This mechanic can be avoided by moving to dodge it or via

to reduce the damage if need be, although these are less efficient.
​
⬥ A blue bar appears above your character. When it drains, a cloud of smoke will cover a 5x5 area centred around your location.

• The smoke deals rapid typeless damage every tick which increases very fast, hitting ~4000 a tick eventually. Move out of it as soon as possible.
    • Move to the place you want to drop it walk out after it drops. Don't panic and walk around unnecessarily, causing you to drop it in an undesirable position.
​
⬥ You may die a few times because the mechanics are quite fast and arguably hard to react to. This is perfectly normal.

Masuta is the second boss of ED1. Expect to eat a lot of food during this fight. Masuta is a fairly hard fight, dealing both high burst and sustained damage on the player. He is considered by some to be the hardest in the dungeon.

⬥ Masuta attacks at the fight using the following rotation:
    • 2-4 autos → Hurricane → 3-5 autos → Tsunami → 3-5 autos → Repeats from Hurricane.
​

Seiryu is the final boss of ED1 and attacks using primarily

⬥ Seiryu first does 4 attacks then continues with the following attack rotation
    • Huge Breath → 2 attacks → Shadow Energy → 2 attacks → repeat
    • Seiryu's standard attack is either a slow

attack (easy to flick) or a tail blackhole.
    • The 2nd Shadow Energy mechanic will be replaced by the Black Hands mechanic.
​
⬥ Seiryu dips his tail into the floor to summon a black hole under the player.

• Summoned blackholes will cover a 2x2 area, dealing rapid and increasing damage (~2000 per tick) to players standing on them, lasting for about 10 seconds before disappearing.
    • Move out (1 tile north/east or 2 tiles south/west) of it to avoid damage.
​
⬥ The message 'Seiryu takes a huge breath!' appears and Seiryu will swing his head from east to west while doing a breath attack.

attack unprotected.
    • You can dodge this attack by standing along the 2 southern rows of the arena. Alternatively, use

.
    • The hit lands when Seiryu's head reaches west making it easy to react to.
​

⬥ The game message 'Shadow energy bursts forth from Seiryu.' appears, and Seiryu launches a shadow projectile towards a tile marked by an arrow. Shortly after, highly damaging black hands will move from the marked tile towards your current location.

• Move out of the way when the black hands spawn.
    • The hands have moderate KO potential so be careful especially if the projectile lands near you.
​
⬥ Replaces Seiryu's 2nd Shadow Energy mechanic. Black hands spawn from a random point along the south wall and move north, expanding out in V-shape pattern.

• These hands are extremely damaging, avoiding them is vital.
    • Take extremely caution especially if using

and don't stand directly at the south wall when this mechanic is imminent.
    • Once this mechanic has been cast, a new set of black hands will spawn when the current formation is complete.
​
⬥ At 7200k HP, Seiryu stops his attacks and lowers his head, all existing mechanics then disappear.
• You will be able to climb the shackle at these two points and start damaging the Black Crystals on the shackle.
• The crystals have 150K HP and can be damaged using

. The fight ends once all of them are destroyed.
    • After some time, 6 shadow enigmas will spawn and slowly move towards Seiryu.
⬩ Upon reaching his face, enigmas will heal crystals by 50k HP each.

⬩ Ignore the first set of enigmas and DPS the crystals.
​

⬥ After the 6th heal is finished, you have 13.2 seconds before you get stunned and teleported back down from the shackle.
    • During this time, a second set of enigmas will have spawned.
        ⬩ Tag and kill them before attacking Seiryu.
    • Seiryu heals back to 7500k HP. Get him down to below 7200k again to continue killing the black crystals.
    • After dragging you down, Seiryu will always start with a Huge Breath attack before continuing his attacking rotation from the previous phase.

        ⬩ Continue attacking Seiryu afterwards.
    • If you kill all 3 crystals during the first shackle segment, the fight ends and this portion will not happen.
